checks.name: batch import commits all source records and complete checkpoint
same immutable file replay does not duplicate records
same import key with changed source bytes is rejected
identical external source IDs remain independent across tenants
higher source version updates the existing scoped record
out-of-order older source version cannot overwrite newer data
same source version with changed content fails without advancing checkpoint
failure within a batch rolls back records and checkpoint together
restart resumes from durable checkpoint after a committed batch
concurrent same-file importers reload checkpoint inside the serialized transaction
whole-file validation rejects bad input before database mutation
invalid batch size and boolean tenant fail early

scope: Real SQLite conditional upserts checkpoints rollback and concurrent connections; injected application interruptions, not machine-crash recovery
